info.title: Gargantua Personal Library — target contract
info.description: Целевой NOT_IMPLEMENTED контракт: default book+audio, раздельная готовность и точные immutable revisions. Данные/связи дополнительно проверяются по объектным правам, квотам, provenance и quality/security policy. JSON fixtures не доказывают качество TTS. Range не поддержан обещанием; проектируется полная выдача.

OutputSelection.description: Omitted SearchRequest.outputs is normalized by the target server to book+audio. Explicit [book] requests text only; JSON Schema default is an annotation, not runtime mutation.

x-known-gaps: Plan schema does not yet cover every scope/budget/evidence/decision field from the domain specification.
Sync deltas/snapshots/conflict payloads, scoped invites/session administration, recipient audit and media transport need further design and implementation.
These schemas and fixture gates are documentation checks; no server, scanner, language quality or APK/EXE feature is implemented by them.
